key_terms: Line and circle relationships: Non-intersecting line, secant (2 intersection points), tangent (1 contact point).
Theorem 10.1: The tangent at any point of a circle is perpendicular to the radius through the point of contact.
Number of tangents from a point:
3. Outside circle: Exactly 2 tangents of equal length.
Theorem 10.2: The lengths of tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are equal (PQ = PR).
The line connecting the center of a circle to an external point bisects the angle between the two tangents.
